sn36.26:1.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn36.26:1.2: katamā nu kho bhante vedanā katamo vedanāsamudayo katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā
sn36.26:1.4: ko vedanāya assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
sn36.26:1.6: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
sn36.26:1.11: yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇanti.
